tags.name: Symphonic Rock
tags.short_description: Rock driven by orchestral arrangement and dramatic structure.
tags.description: Suitable for tracks that combine a rock band core with symphonic strings, brass, choir, or cinematic orchestration.

tags.name: Electronic
tags.short_description: Electronic production centered on synths, sequencing, and digital timbre.
tags.description: General-purpose electronic music tag for tracks built around synthesizers, programmed rhythm, and digital sound design.

tags.name: Eurobeat
tags.short_description: High-tempo dance music with bright synth leads and driving rhythm.
tags.description: Useful for fast, energetic dance tracks with four-on-the-floor pulse, layered synth hooks, and a strong club-oriented feel.

tags.name: Jazz Fusion
tags.short_description: Jazz language blended with rock, funk, or modern electric instrumentation.
tags.description: Appropriate for tracks that combine jazz harmony and improvisational texture with electric instrumentation and groove-heavy rhythm sections.

tags.name: Folk
tags.short_description: Folk-oriented writing with acoustic texture and traditional melodic flavor.
tags.description: Can be used for tracks led by acoustic instruments, dance-like traditional rhythm, or regionally inflected melodic phrasing.

tags.name: Progressive Rock
tags.short_description: Rock with long-form structure, shifting meter, and expanded harmonic scope.
tags.description: Suitable for tracks that emphasize suite-like development, technical arrangement, and frequent structural change.

tags.name: Power Metal
tags.short_description: Melodic metal built around speed, uplift, and prominent lead guitar.
tags.description: Useful for energetic metal tracks with bright harmonized riffs, double-kick drive, and anthem-like melodic hooks.

tags.name: Melodic Death Metal
tags.short_description: Death metal intensity shaped by strong melodic riff writing.
tags.description: Appropriate for tracks that combine aggressive drumming and distorted guitar tone with pronounced lead melody and harmonic motion.

tags.name: Post-rock
tags.short_description: Atmospheric rock focused on gradual build, texture, and dynamic arc.
tags.description: Use for instrumental or semi-instrumental tracks that emphasize layering, expansion, and emotional crescendo over verse-chorus form.

tags.name: Shoegaze
tags.short_description: Dense guitar texture with haze, reverb, and submerged vocal presence.
tags.description: Fits tracks led by layered effects-heavy guitar walls, soft-focus harmony, and immersive wash-like timbre.

tags.name: Trance
tags.short_description: Melodic dance music built on repetition, build-up, and release.
tags.description: Use for tracks with extended synth motion, driving pulse, and tension-release phrasing aimed at a euphoric club feel.

tags.name: House
tags.short_description: Four-on-the-floor dance music with groove-centered structure.
tags.description: Appropriate for tracks organized around steady kick pulse, loop-based layering, and dancefloor-oriented rhythmic flow.

tags.name: Drum and Bass
tags.short_description: Fast breakbeat-driven electronic music with active bass movement.
tags.description: Useful for tracks built from chopped or rolling break rhythms, sub-bass pressure, and high-energy forward motion.

tags.name: Hardcore
tags.short_description: High-intensity dance music with aggressive rhythm and impact.
tags.description: Use for tracks that push tempo, transient attack, and relentless pulse toward an extreme club sound.

tags.name: Ambient
tags.short_description: Atmosphere-first music centered on space, tone, and sustain.
tags.description: Appropriate for pieces that prioritize texture, resonance, and environmental mood over strong beat or melody.

tags.name: Orchestral
tags.short_description: Music led by orchestral writing, ensemble color, and cinematic scope.
tags.description: Use for tracks whose primary identity comes from strings, brass, woodwinds, percussion, or concert-style ensemble arrangement.

tags.name: Chiptune
tags.short_description: Music using chip-like synthesis or game-console timbral language.
tags.description: Fits tracks that foreground square-wave leads, retro digital tone, and intentionally game-like sound palette.

tags.name: Piano Solo
tags.short_description: Solo piano presentation with no other defining instrumental layer.
tags.description: Use for tracks whose arrangement is carried almost entirely by a single piano performance.

tags.name: String Quartet
tags.short_description: Chamber writing for a small string ensemble texture.
tags.description: Appropriate for arrangements centered on intimate, contrapuntal, and ensemble-based string interplay.

tags.name: Bossa Nova
tags.short_description: Soft syncopated groove associated with Brazilian jazz-pop idiom.
tags.description: Useful for laid-back tracks driven by gentle syncopation, light harmonic color, and understated rhythmic sway.

tags.name: Swing
tags.short_description: Jazz-derived groove with bounced rhythm and danceable momentum.
tags.description: Use for tracks that lean on swung subdivision, brass or reed phrasing, and a lively big-band or combo feel.

tags.name: Tango
tags.short_description: Rhythmic dramatic style with sharp phrasing and dance tension.
tags.description: Suitable for tracks that use clipped articulation, dramatic cadence, and a strongly shaped push-pull rhythmic character.

tags.name: Waltz
tags.short_description: Triple-meter dance character with rotating lyrical motion.
tags.description: Appropriate for tracks clearly organized around a 3-beat pulse and flowing circular phrase shape.

tags.name: March
tags.short_description: Processional style built on regular step-like pulse and clear accent.
tags.description: Use for music that evokes parade, military, or ceremonial momentum through strong metric regularity.

tags.name: Ballad
tags.short_description: Song-focused slow or moderate style emphasizing lyrical melody and emotional delivery.
tags.description: Useful for tracks whose primary identity is a broad vocal line, steady harmony, and expressive pacing.

tags.name: Touhou Arrange
tags.short_description: Fan arrangement practice centered on Touhou Project source material.
tags.description: Marks music created within the arrange tradition around Touhou melodies, motifs, and derivative reinterpretation.

tags.name: Game Music Arrangement
tags.short_description: Arrangement culture built around reinterpretation of game soundtrack material.
tags.description: Use for works whose identity is shaped by arranging, reharmonizing, or stylistically recasting existing game music.

tags.name: Doujin Music
tags.short_description: Independent fan and creator scene around self-published music works.
tags.description: Useful for works or styles closely associated with doujin circles, convention culture, and self-published releases.

tags.name: Club-oriented
tags.short_description: Music framed by DJ, dancefloor, or nightlife playback context.
tags.description: Use when a track's arrangement and pacing are strongly aimed at club play, mixing, or dancefloor energy.

tags.name: Live-band Arrange
tags.short_description: Arrangement style oriented toward live players and stage performance.
tags.description: Appropriate for tracks that clearly read as ensemble-performed rather than primarily sequenced in the studio.

tags.name: Vocal
tags.short_description: Track includes a sung vocal performance.
tags.description: Use when vocals are a defining audible element rather than a small incidental sample or spoken excerpt.

tags.name: Instrumental
tags.short_description: Track has no lead vocal and is primarily instrumental.
tags.description: Use for pieces carried by melody, arrangement, or improvisation without a sung top-line.

tags.name: Piano-led
tags.short_description: Piano is the dominant lead or accompaniment instrument.
tags.description: Applies when piano defines the track's texture, harmonic motion, or melodic focus.

tags.name: Guitar-led
tags.short_description: Guitar is the main lead, riff, or timbral anchor.
tags.description: Use when guitar defines the track's melodic identity, groove, or surface texture.

tags.name: String-led
tags.short_description: String section or string ensemble is the dominant color.
tags.description: Appropriate when violin, viola, cello, or broader string writing shapes the core listening impression.

tags.name: Choir
tags.short_description: Choral texture is a major element of the arrangement.
tags.description: Use for tracks with layered group vocals, chant, or ensemble voice used as a principal timbral force.

tags.name: Fast-paced
tags.short_description: Track presents a clearly high-speed rhythmic feel.
tags.description: Useful when rapid pulse, dense note activity, or aggressive momentum is central to the track's character.

tags.name: Atmospheric
tags.short_description: Track emphasizes mood, space, and immersive texture.
tags.description: Use when the listening impression is defined more by environment and tone than by direct hook or rhythmic force.

tags.name: Melancholic
tags.short_description: Track projects reflective, wistful, or sorrow-tinged affect.
tags.description: Appropriate for pieces whose melodic contour, harmony, and pacing strongly suggest sadness or longing.

tags.name: Aggressive
tags.short_description: Track presents forceful attack, intensity, and forward pressure.
tags.description: Use when distortion, rhythmic strike, or performance attitude creates a clearly confrontational sonic feel.

tags.name: Cinematic
tags.short_description: Track evokes soundtrack-like scale, pacing, or dramatic framing.
tags.description: Useful for music that feels scene-setting, narrative, or visually staged through orchestration and dynamic arc.
